worst_flaw: The design has no comparison group and treats the before-and-after coverage change as only feasibility evidence, yet it uses that comparison to decide whether to scale. It also leaves a gap between its own goals and its scale rule. The weekly goal of 3 credits is not tied to the 30% coverage target. Resolution time, a likely displacement effect with the CSAT bonus at stake, is never measured; only CSAT is checked.
